chapter_b_multi_disease.body_system_coverage_status: DKA/endocrine-metabolic, sepsis/systemic-infectious, AKI/renal, respiratory/pulmonary, cardiovascular, neurologic-proxy, hepatic-GI, first-class hematologic/coagulation, electrolyte/acid-base, broad endocrine stress, GI/pancreatic/nutrition, cardiac injury, musculoskeletal/rhabdomyolysis, and immune/inflammatory modules now have isolated factual-router contracts.

electrolyte_acid_base.caveat: random patient splits pass, but hospital-heldout normalized MAE regresses versus persistence

long_horizon.interpretation: Slow renal targets are a horizon problem: creatinine/BUN fall back to persistence at 6h but select ridge_realfit at 24h and 48h.

mechanism_candidate.interpretation: A simple 6-hour renal accumulation prior does not robustly beat persistence for slow creatinine/BUN targets.

gate.pass_rule: candidate must significantly beat both baseline and capacity-matched placebo on downstream observable targets

renal_belief.interpretation: Renal belief is useful as patient-specific personalization on long-horizon AKI forecasts, not as a direct hidden-state truth claim or causal model.

gate.pass_rule: candidate must significantly beat both baseline and capacity-matched placebo on downstream observable targets

renal_belief_state.interpretation: The explicit online-compatible predict-update belief state is partially validated: useful for BUN and 24h urine output, not yet for creatinine.

gate.pass_rule: candidate must significantly beat both baseline and capacity-matched placebo on downstream observable targets

renal_belief_state_v2.interpretation: Adding a creatinine-specific level/slope/innovation state fixes the prior explicit state's creatinine gap and creates the current best online-compatible renal belief candidate.

coagulopathy_heme.interpretation: Heme/coag is no longer just a platelet/WBC proxy: hemoglobin and hematocrit select ridge_realfit in 7/7 splits, INR has partial signal, and transfusion evidence includes volume/dose-observed intakeOutput rows.

gate.pass_rule: candidate must significantly beat both baseline and capacity-matched placebo on downstream observable targets

heme_coag_belief.interpretation: Bleeding/coagulation reserve beliefs show partial hemoglobin/hematocrit signal, but no target reaches robust 7/7 placebo-gated validation and hospital-heldout does not pass.

long_horizon.interpretation: 24h strengthens hemoglobin/hematocrit factual routing, but 48h weakens heme lab source selection and coagulation cascade targets remain persistence at both horizons.

respiratory_failure.interpretation: A narrow respiratory/ARDS/ventilator-coded eICU module validates the same factual router pattern; oxygenation, respiratory-rate, perfusion, heart-rate, pH, and most bicarbonate splits select ridge_realfit.

chapter_b_multi_disease.next_engineering_step: Heme/coag long-horizon audit is complete: 24h strengthens Hgb/Hct factual routing, but INR/PTT/fibrinogen/platelets remain persistence. Next depth work should improve transfusion-dose/product subtype observability or add first-class neuro/hepatic variables.

templates.cohort_definition: suspected infection plus organ dysfunction or SepsisLabel, with hourly vitals/labs and treatment timing
notes: Start as factual router using PhysioNet/eICU/MIMIC trajectories.
Do not claim antibiotic or fluid causal effects from observational EHR.
templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: KDIGO-like creatinine or urine-output change with medication and hemodynamic context
notes: Use belief states for renal reserve and sodium-water balance.
Persistence will be strong for creatinine; router must fall back.
templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: ARDS / ventilator-coded respiratory failure or severe measured hypoxemia with respiratory vitals, oxygenation, acid-base, and observed respiratory treatment evidence
notes: Start as factual router; do not claim oxygen or ventilation causal effects from observational EHR.
Asthma-specific peak-flow/work-of-breathing targets remain a future non-ICU data problem.
templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: cardiogenic shock / heart failure / acute coronary / arrhythmia diagnosis support with hemodynamic, lactate, renal, and electrolyte targets
notes: Use as hemodynamic factual router only.
Vasopressor/inotrope treatment effects stay Chapter-A closed.
templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: stroke / intracranial hemorrhage / seizure / coma / encephalopathy diagnosis support with physiologic proxy targets

templates.safety_boundary: research factual advisory only until patient-held-out, symbolic, causal-readiness, and clinical-review gates pass

templates.cohort_definition: hepatic failure / cirrhosis / hepatic encephalopathy diagnosis support with bilirubin, platelet, lactate, renal, and perfusion targets
